build_widerface_dataset_builder: build a WiderFace tfds dataset builder to download and generate face detection examples from WIDER FACE benchmark
create_widerface_dataset_info: create dataset info with image, filename, and face bounding box features for the WIDER FACE dataset
generate_widerface_examples: generate WIDER FACE dataset examples by parsing annotation files and yielding image records with face bounding boxes
split_widerface_dataset: split WIDER FACE dataset into train, validation, and test splits with downloaded and extracted archives
download_widerface_archives: download and extract WIDER FACE train, val, test, and annotation archives for dataset generation
